import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int[][][][] shortest = new int[15][15][15][15];
    static int[][] cap = new int[400][400];
    static char[][] scien = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] reac = new char[20][20];
    static int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int iter = 3;
    static int[] vis = new int[400];
    
    static int n, t;
    
    static int aug(int cnode, int dest, int bneck) {
        if (cnode == dest) {
            return bneck;
        }
        if (vis[cnode] == iter) {
            return 0;
        }
        vis[cnode] = iter;
        for (int i = 0; i <= dest; i++) {
            int cret = 0;
            if (cap[cnode][i] > 0 && (cret = aug(i, dest, Math.min(bneck, cap[cnode][i]))) != 0) {
                cap[cnode][i] -= cret;
                cap[i][cnode] += cret;
                return cret;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    static int getnode(int x, int y) {
        return (x - 1) * n + y - 1;
    }
    
    static int[][] reach = new int[13][13];
    static int[][] treach = new int[13][13];
    
    static void expand(int val) {
        int i, j, k;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (j = 1; j <= n; j++)
                treach[i][j] = reach[i][j];
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (treach[i][j] == val) {
                    for (k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                        int ni = i + dx[k];
                        int nj = j + dy[k];
                        if (ni > 0 && nj > 0 && ni <= n && nj <= n && treach[ni][nj] < val && scien[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                            reach[ni][nj] = val;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static boolean canreach(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty, int ix, int iy) {
        for (i = 0; i < 13; i++) {
            for (j = 0; j < 13; j++) {
                reach[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        reach[sx][sy] = 1;
        reach[ix][iy] = 2;
        int iters = 100;
        while (iters-- > 0) {
            expand(1);
            if (reach[tx][ty] == 1)
                return true;
            expand(2);
            if (reach[tx][ty] == 2)
                return false; 
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int infx = 0, infy = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 15; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 15; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < 15; l++) {
                        shortest[i][j][k][l] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        
        int i, j;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            scien[i] = line.toCharArray();
            for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                shortest[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                if (scien[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    infx = i;
                    infy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            reac[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                    int ni = i + dx[k];
                    int nj = j + dy[k];
                    if (ni <= n && ni > 0 && nj <= n && nj > 0) {
                        if (scien[i][j] != 'Y' && scien[ni][nj] != 'Y')
                            shortest[i][j][ni][nj] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int ki, kj, ii, ij, ji, jj;
        for (ki = 1; ki <= n; ki++) {
            for (kj = 1; kj <= n; kj++) {
                for (ii = 1; ii <= n; ii++) {
                    for (ij = 1; ij <= n; ij++) {
                        for (ji = 1; ji <= n; ji++) {
                            for (jj = 1; jj <= n; jj++) {
                                shortest[ii][ij][ji][jj] = Math.min(
                                        shortest[ii][ij][ji][jj], 
                                        shortest[ii][ij][ki][kj] + shortest[ki][kj][ji][jj]
                                        );
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int src = n * n * 2 + 1;
        int dest = n * n * 2 + 2;
        
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(scien[i][j])) {
                    cap[src][getnode(i, j)] = scien[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(reac[i][j])) {
                    cap[n * n + getnode(i, j)][dest] = reac[i][j] - '0';
                }

                if (Character.isDigit(scien[i][j])) {
                    for (ki = 1; ki <= n; ki++) {
                        for (kj = 1; kj <= n; kj++) {
                            if (scien[i][j] > '0' && reac[ki][kj] > '0') {
                                if (Character.isDigit(reac[ki][kj]) && shortest[i][j][ki][kj] <= t && canreach(i, j, ki, kj, infx, infy)) {
                                    cap[getnode(i, j)][n * n + getnode(ki, kj)] = 1000;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int mflow = 0, ret;
        while ((ret = aug(src, dest, 1000)) != 0) {
            mflow += ret;
            iter++;
        }
        
        System.out.println(mflow);
    }
}
